ExecutableTestSuite.label: Conformance Class 4b: INSPIRE Network Services metadata for Monitoring.
ExecutableTestSuite.description:
This test suite examines metadata records against the requirements for metadata in INSPIRE.

Please report any issues or problems in GitHub.

Known limitations are documented in the description of the applicable test case or test assertion.

There is a general limitation in all assertions that polymorphism and containment by reference (see the Technical Guidance, sub-clauses A.3, A.4 and A.5) are not supported. However, the current Abstract Test Suite does not support polymorphism and references either (all XPath expressions do not support polymorhism or references; in addition, schema validation is only executed against the ISO/OGC schemas without extensions). It is therefore unclear if this is really a limitation or if the sections in the technical guidance are outdated.

Source: Conformance Class 4b: INSPIRE Network Services metadata for Monitoring.'

Pre-requisite conformance classes: Conformance Class 4
ExecutableTestSuite.author: Inspire Team

ParameterList.name: ETF Standard Parameters for metadata XML test objects

TestCase.label: Monitoring requirements
TestCase.description: Execute tests that apply for monitoring network service.

TestAssertion.label: md ns 4b: Network Service Conformity for Monitoring
TestAssertion.description:
Test that the service metadata includes information on the degree of conformity with the implementing rules for network services.

More information: Network services conformity
TestAssertion.expression: let $specificationText := '976/2009' let $messages := (for $record in $records let $rid := $record/gmd:fileIdentifier/gco:CharacterString/text() let $conformityResult := $record/gmd:report/gmd:DQ_DomainConsistency/gmd:result/gmd:DQ_ConformanceResult let $specification := $conformityResult/gmd:specification/gmd:CI_Citation/gmd:title/*/text() return if (not($conformityResult)) then local:addMessage('TR.noConformityStatement', map { 'filename': local:filename($record), 'id': $rid }) else if (not(contains($specification, $specificationText))) then local:addMessage('TR.wrongConformitySpecification', map { 'filename': local:filename($record), 'id': $rid, 'specification': $specification }) else () )[position() le $limitErrors] return (if ($messages) then 'FAILED' else 'PASSED', local:error-statistics('TR.recordsWithErrors', count(fn:distinct-values($messages//etf:argument[@token='id']/text()))), $messages)
